subject: Main Street Liquors Underage Sales Hearing
overview: The Medford Liquor License Commission approved several one-day and entertainment licenses, reviewed outstanding meeting minutes, and approved its 2024 annual report. The commission also held a disciplinary hearing regarding four alleged underage alcohol sales at Main Street Liquors, taking the matter under advisement.

items.title: One-Day License: Mary Queen of Peace Parish
items.summary: Approved a one-day liquor license for Mary Queen of Peace Parish's February 1 speed dating event, conditioned on receipt of a certificate of insurance.

items.title: One-Day Licenses: Arts Collaborative Medford
items.summary: Approved three one-day licenses for Arts Collaborative Medford for events on February 6, February 9, and February 20.

items.title: Entertainment License: El Tacuba
items.summary: Approved an entertainment license application for televisions and background music at El Tacuba at 35 Salem Street.

items.title: Change of Manager: Ocean State Job Lot
items.summary: Tabled the change of manager application for Ocean State Job Lot until next month due to the applicant's absence.

items.title: Disciplinary Hearing: Main Street Liquors
items.summary: Held a hearing on four police allegations of alcohol sales to individuals under 21 years old on January 3, 2025, and voted to take the matter under advisement before issuing a penalty.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes covering July 17 through December 18, 2024, with minor attendance corrections.

items.title: 2024 Annual Report
items.summary: Approved the commission's 2024 annual report for submission to the Alcoholic Beverages Control Commission.

items.title: Commission Discussion and Updates
items.summary: Discussed transfer timing for The Establishment, common victualler operating hours at Gab, a proposed licensee newsletter, local adoption of Sunday morning alcohol sales under state law, and ID scanning equipment.
